steps.note: Arrange the twelve 6 × 8 plates on a flat surface.
steps.title: Foundation

steps.note: Add the offset upper layer. Complete it before lifting the base.
steps.title: Lock the foundation

steps.note: Fit the pale-grey exterior and tan interior tiles. Leave the marked studded attachment areas.
steps.title: Paved courtyard

steps.note: Build the low sills and tan entrance pillars.
steps.title: Window sills and pillars

steps.note: Fit the lower side and rear frames with their matching panes.
steps.title: Lower glazing

steps.note: Add the upper windows and the glazed entrance door. Insert panes before the cornice.
steps.title: Upper glazing and entrance

steps.note: Build the counter inside the open serving arch, then add its white mug.
steps.title: Cafe counter

steps.note: Add both large arches, the small tan entrance arch, and the four outer-pillar fillers.
steps.title: Arched facade

steps.note: Tie the walls with two crossing plate layers. Keep the central glazed opening clear.
steps.title: Roof cornice

steps.note: Make the lantern rail subassembly: connect the three lower beams with the two eave rows before placing it on the cornice. Add the upper rails and shoulder trim.
steps.title: Lantern support frame

steps.note: Fit the four fixed windscreens in opposing pairs; cap and tie their upper studs.
steps.title: Glass roof

steps.note: Build the timber bench and compact square table.
steps.title: Bench and bistro table

steps.note: Add the brown raised beds and brown mounting plates.
steps.title: Raised garden beds

steps.note: Attach leaves and flowers at the recorded studs; finish with the table mug.
steps.title: Flowers and finishing
